leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Initialize a message state array to track sent messages and their delivery statuses.
Construct a function to send a new message and assign it a unique identifier and pending status.
Implement a simulated acknowledgment handler that updates a specific message's status to 'delivered'.
Integrate the send function with a user input event to trigger message creation.
Configure a display component to render the list of messages with their current delivery status.
Manipulate the state array by filtering or mapping to show only delivered messages in a separate view.
Bind the acknowledgment handler to a timer or event to simulate server response and update the UI.
lessonTitle: Build chat message delivery ack flow
